identity.standaloneProfile: signed-permit client bootstrap bound to appId=correspondence
identity.schoolProfile: server-session enforcement remains deferred until an approved school runtime exists
identity.rule: Client-supplied role, ownership or app identity is never sufficient evidence for a future server-side protected operation.

requestApiAi.controls: GHRAB AI Core registry, bounded request sizes, anonymization and privacy preflight, schema-bound operation IDs, no autonomous tool or action executor.

egress.standalone: direct-gemini only, explicitly selected by the standalone runtime profile, without automatic fallback
egress.school: same-origin school-gateway only; provider egress and provider credentials belong outside the browser and remain server-phase deferred
egress.crossApp: No child application receives a generic cross-application network or administrative capability.

files.currentBoundary: User-controlled text and supported local imports are parsed in the browser and pass existing type, size, privacy and sanitization checks before AI use.
files.serverBoundary: Upload quarantine and server-side document processing are deferred with the school-server phase; no LIVE claim is made for them.

dataLifecycle.storage: Namespaced local/session storage and PWA cache under the existing data manifest and suite-session cleanup rules.
dataLifecycle.retention: Configured retention is 30 days; shared-device cleanup and explicit data deletion remain part of the existing baseline.

release.legacyRegression: GARP-2.5.1 tooling R5 and N5 controls remain mandatory regression inputs and are not relabeled as GARP 2.7.
release.promotion: candidate -> cumulative security gate -> pull request -> protected main -> exact release identity -> verified public Pages release -> app-updated
release.publicAssurance: TRANSITIONAL unsigned Pages release; school-server SHIELD-LIVE and RI-LIVE remain deferred.

inventory.changeRule: A new AI operation, egress mode, import class, privileged capability or release authority requires inventory update and matching tests before admission.

securityHealth.localCi: GARP 2.7 contract, architecture-integrity, mutation, secret, legacy GARP 2.5.1 and release-chain gates remain active without the school server.
securityHealth.live: NOT_TESTED until an approved target runtime supplies trusted runtime evidence.
securityHealth.failureMode: Harness error, empty scope, stale or mismatched evidence and missing required controls never become PASS.

incident.current: Existing bounded error reporter, release evidence and fail-closed promotion path are retained; diagnostic content remains minimized and user-controlled.
incident.future: Central server monitoring, watchdog and infrastructure containment are deferred and must be reviewed separately before use.

recovery.current: Safe Promotion, exact release identity, rollback-aware release-integrity tooling and local data cleanup remain the recovery baseline.
recovery.future: Server restore, trust-root custody and live recovery drills are NOT_TESTED until the school runtime is approved.
